rows.summary: Newgen Software Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Newgen Software Technologies (UK) Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Newgen Software Technologies Limited ( the Company ) incorporated in the UK, has executed an agreement with a customer for providing a document management system, including implementation services, software licenses, cloud hosting, maintenance and support services. The aggregate value of the aforesaid Agreement is GBP £1.63million (One Million, six hundred and thirty thousand pounds).
